Model conventions

  • Risk-free input: Fixed 2.00% effective annual cash assumption. This is a cash-return proxy used for excess-return metrics.
  • Portfolio rebalancing: monthly; benchmark: monthly; trades occur at the first observed session's close in the new period.
  • Cost: 5 basis points per dollar bought or sold. The cost is paid from portfolio value.
  • The portfolio begins already invested. Initial purchase and terminal liquidation costs are excluded for all strategies.
  • Adjusted total-return units include provider adjustments. Dividends are not added again.
  • Missing prices are never forward-filled. Only common observed sessions are used.
  • CAGR uses elapsed calendar years; volatility and moment-based ratios use 252 sessions per year.
  • Universe selection is fixed. No taxes, leverage, external cash flows, or live order execution.

Data-quality findings

  • No flagged issues under the implemented quality checks.
